Sure — I'm trying to find which branch Dr. Okafor works out of.
Okay, so you want the branch location, right?
Yeah, that’s right — which branch is she at?
Sure, our clinic is located on 123 Main Street, across from the Northwell campus.
Yeah, he actually works at downtown branch in Los Angeles.

Thanks for that — I’ll note the Downtown branch in Los Angeles and then I’m all set. Sorry, I need one more detail — is that the only Downtown branch in Los Angeles, or can you share the site name or street address?
